decisions: The collection owns values, defaults, aggregate validity and repeated form entries; member native participation is suppressed.
Only enabled registered members serialize; temporarily absent values remain canonical until their members return.
An actions slot outside the native label supplies independent controls, including controls with their own state.
Explicit member size overrides general Group, then a logical collection default, then the component default.
Each selection boundary exposes its own acme-change payload; independent actions use direct handlers.
limits: Radio/groups/cards, Switch, Segmented Control/Tabs/indicator and Theme Switcher remain M10.
Native form ownership follows the collection element tree scope. Wrappers with their own shadow forms must associate the collection with the intended native form.
Native validity and lifecycle evidence remains distinct from assistive-technology speech output and real history/autofill acceptance.
